notes.title: DEVLOG: COSMIC FEAR - PROGRESS UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Welcome back to another devlog for my upcoming game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3306920/Cosmic_Fear/]Cosmic Fear[/url]. I’m thrilled to share some exciting updates on the progress as I continue to bring this Lovecraftian horror adventure to life.

[previewyoutube=8QND2UhKSoU;full][/previewyoutube]
I've been crafting new environments that will take you deeper into the unknown.
The latest environments are inspired by some of the eeriest corners of the universe, blending Lovecraftian horror with breathtakingly beautiful yet haunting landscapes. I’m paying close attention to every detail, from the creepy soundscapes to the dynamic lighting effects, to ensure that each environment feels unique and contributes to the overall atmosphere of dread.

Here's a sneak peek at what I’ve been working on:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27862879/c7e2f639436fc6c16665871734d04471c7f1098a.jpg[/img]
I’m excited for you to explore these new areas and uncover the secrets they hold.


In addition to the world building, I’m also working on the save system:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27862879/95a12baf238c0f385012891dbc0557980ffb4091.jpg[/img]
Join me on Youtube!

I’m often live on my [url=https://www.youtube.com/@alessandroguzzo]Youtube channel[/url] where you can join me while I play games, as well as dive deep into game development discussions, share tips and tricks, and interact with you. It's a great way to stay connected, and I can't wait to see you there and chat with you all in real-time!


Don't forget to grab the Cosmic Horror bundle on sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23128/Cosmic_Horror_Bundle/

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm!

notes.title: The Alien Cube DEMO Release Date revealed!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'm happy to announce that The Alien Cube DEMO will be available on Friday 20th December 2019! ːsteamhappyː
Save the date and get ready to play the first part of the full game!
Please feel free to share the game on your socials.

Thank you all for allowing this to happen ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
I've just patched the game with the version 1.02 (the same as the experimental version).
CHANGELOG:
-crashes fixed
-improved performance and stability in particular with low-end PCs
-rebuilt lights and fogs
-fixed a bug that didn't show a hint when you pick-up the chainsaw

notes.title: RELEASE INFO!
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

I’m happy to announce that The Land of Pain will be released in September 2017!
I can’t wait for you to explore the dark world I’ve been working on for the past few years. ːsteamhappyː 
It’s been a huge work for a sole developer, but now everything is completed. I couldn’t have made it without your constant support and I’m proud of the final result. 

Thank you all!

Stay tuned in the next days, there will be important announcements!
